missed_qualifications: Footnote 3 is supplied in da12aecad4e68.u30.3569: “Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.” The XML and PDF items carry marker 3; their permissions must retain this requirement. The claims' assertions that footnote 3 is missing are incorrect. No marker appears on the web-form item, so extending the requirement to that method is unsupported by the retained text.

The XML obligation also includes technical-test coordination. da12aecad4e68.u14.2439 requires firms to “liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition.” This is additional to following the separately supplied schema.

The format permissions inherit the parent requirement in da12aecad4e68.u3.811: “Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:”. A permitted format does not authorize an alternative channel; a format or e-Cert defect does not by itself establish that the channel was other than STREAMS 2.

The calendar-date trigger remains an interpretation, not an entailed boundary. da12aecad4e68.u28.3334 says “following its implementation”, while da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 specifies “the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026”. The date-only parent clause does not settle treatment of pre-launch filings that morning.

Registration uses SHOULD: “Licensed firms should register STREAMS 2 user accounts to facilitate the prompt submission of STRs.” (da12aecad4e68.u8.1235). Its facilitative relevance does not establish a mandatory prerequisite, an exception to the channel rule, or an additional resubmission-trigger condition.

The candidates' scope uses the shared definition in da12aecad4e68.u0.0: “licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”)”. This definition also governs the supplied claims.
